## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**

      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Garlicks_, Jun 30, 2026, 4/5: "As a lot of reviews have already stated, it’s a really good app and so well thought out. I look forward to using it each day. That said, in the last month or so, the app is quite buggy, and as a fairly new user still, I do have a few gripes: - Recently, it takes a lot longer to open and start up the app - I would love to be able to download workouts to use without internet connection - It would be great if workouts could run in the background/ with the phone screen off - After completion of a recent challenge yesterday (29th June), this congratulatory banner kept appearing, and the only way to get rid of it was to join a new challenge. And now, I cannot find a way to exit that challenge I didn’t even want to sign up to. The chatbot instructions do not help, the three menu dots it directs me to never appear"
